## Change summary

Describe the user-visible and backend behavior being changed.

## Convex release review

- [ ] No backend or database change.
- [ ] Backend/schema change is additive and backward compatible.
- [ ] Migration/backfill is resumable and idempotent.
- [ ] Tested against the isolated self-hosted staging deployment.
- [ ] Staging snapshot/import used redacted or explicitly approved production data.
- [ ] Table counts and critical invariants were recorded before and after rehearsal.
- [ ] Rollback or forward-fix steps are documented.
- [ ] A verified production backup will be completed immediately before release.

## Verification

List the commands, tests, staging URLs, and evidence used to verify this change.
